abhts_16.1.literal: Now (atha) [is] of-absent-one (parokṣasya) initiation (dīkṣā) — twofold (dvividhā ca) [is] it (saḥ): dead (mṛtaḥ) and-living (jīvaṃś ca)
abhts_16.1.note: | kept confirmed (ralph loop re-mine preserved prior confirm)

abhts_16.7.literal: As-far-as (yāvad) [is] with-smoke- lovely-thick-net-covered-course-wheel (dhūmābhirāmapracitataraśikhājālakenādhvacakram) having- covered (saṃchādya) [is] desired-soul-bringing (abhīṣṭajīvānayanam) — thus (iti) [is] great (mahāñ) net-named (jālanāmā) practice (prayogaḥ)

abhts_16.13.literal: For-the-Lord-itself (parameśvaraḥ eva hi) through-teacher-body-abiding-door (guruśarīrādhiṣṭhānadvāreṇa) the-to-be-graced (anugrāhyān) graces (anugṛhṇāti)

abhts_16.16.literal: Here (atra) [is] more (paraṃ) by-full- offering (pūrṇāhutyā) of-it (tasya) kuśa-and-rest-form (dārbhādyākārasya) in-supreme-glow-dissolution (paratejasi layaḥ) to-be-made (kartavyaḥ)
